verdicts.ruling_text: In every Test-S family the per-comparison p-value is the two-sided paired role-block bootstrap p-value of evaluate.paired_mdsa with the +1 correction (B = 2,000, seed 0); a hypothesis's p-value is the largest over all its claim comparators (all of §2.5 for Track N) and counts only if every point difference favours the arm; Holm is step-down with monotone adjusted p-values; and the per-seed-unit rule applies to H2-S, Track N and small lakes exactly as to H1-S.

verdicts.ruling_text: LEAD rule 5 binds M2 in full: before each dev_v5m, context-cache or comparator build `df -h /` must show at least 60 GB free after the projected size, otherwise stop and report; all derived dev_v5m artefacts together stay under 10 GB; M2 CPU jobs run one at a time with at most 6 threads; and no imagery is downloaded.

points.ruling: Confirm as written; it replaces the lead's words 'same 3-init averaging'; no comparator ensemble is reduced later; the MDN_B + GBM average becomes a claim comparator (CMP-1).

points.ruling: Confirm. Out-of-fold features from the fit cell only, folds grouped by role block, every member counted. The trophic-chain OLS uses the same out-of-fold rule (CMP-2).

points.point: 6. Track N arm when v2 = A0, or when A1 fails (§2.7)
points.ruling: Confirm the default. The A1 configuration scored on Track N is chosen by validation chl-a only, never by a Track N validation number; it is not a third arm in H1-S or H2-S; the per-seed-unit rule applies to it; if A1 fails its kill criterion no SENTINEL claim is made on Track N.
points.reason: The arm is fixed by a rule with no fork. The additions close the two remaining choices (selection by a Track N number, an extra arm in the base families).

points.point: 7. Shared initialisation fixed when A0 starts (§3.1)
points.ruling: Change. No A0 or A1 network starts before the v1 dev_v5 selection is registered and written into a regenerated, independently reviewed v1 freeze candidate; both arms take the recipe and initialisation named there, recorded by its sha256; nothing later changes either arm.
points.reason: Reviewers offered a lead-set clock time or an event. The event is stricter: it removes the author's control of the moment and makes §3.1 agree with §3.3, which already defines A0 from the frozen headline configuration. It only delays v2 training, so it can be carried out.

points.ruling: Accept the default: fine-tuning auxiliary head only, GLORIA pretraining unchanged, dropped before any training if the fit cell holds fewer than 200 values, descriptive.
points.reason: Changing pretraining would change the initialisation shared with A0 and v1 and break the attribution. The drop rule is a count rule.

points.point: 9. H2-S family with small TSS and NTU counts (§6.3)
points.ruling: Change. Secchi, TSS and turbidity-NTU are each confirmatory only with at least 30 role blocks in the primary cell and a binding MDE80 of at most 15 points against every claim comparator; otherwise pre-declared descriptive. Holm divisor stays 6. NTU-class rows only.
points.reason: Reviewers differ on scope; the union is stricter. dev_v4 Test-S holds 92 TSS and 49 turbidity rows in under 30 blocks, where a cluster bootstrap is unreliable. A fixed divisor removes any gain from declaring a target descriptive.

points.ruling: Confirm: not adopted. Adding it later needs its own stamped addendum before any validation number.
points.reason: No model receives it, so parity holds without further rules.

points.ruling: Confirm, with these conditions: v2 guard and loaders independently reviewed before any dev_v5m build reads a new-target value; look-specific parts re-implemented in orbit_v2 with no run-time patching of v1 modules; tests use a temporary runs root; the claim refuses a non-empty look folder; per-unit and per-network predictions are sealed; the power script is new code with a registered hash; 'hashed by v1' means guard.frozen_files().
points.reason: Separation protects the v1 candidate. But the hashed set is 45 files, not four globs, the v1 look list is hard-coded, and orbit_power.py cannot be reused unedited. The conditions are the union of the three reviewers' and are all feasible.

points.point: 12. Early stopping on the four base targets; a-priori ranges (§3.4 item 9, §2.1)
points.ruling: Confirm. Ranges are fixed now and never revised after any value is seen; out-of-range values are set missing and counted per target.
points.reason: New-target labels then cannot move the stopping point of the base-target claims, and the criterion matches v1 and A0.

points.point: G1. Track G draft: Test-S interaction (G-A1 item 5)
points.ruling: Accept. Archive-year G1-G5 rows of test-role lakes are counted by key, never used for training or tuning in either build order, and left unused once M2S/test is sealed.
points.reason: It keeps Test-S fixed whichever of Track G and M2S/test is built first. Track G is a draft and not funded, so this binds only at its own stamp.

points.point: G2. Track G draft: v2 = c1 (G-A2 against G-A4)
points.ruling: c2 is the single Track-G configuration whenever v2 is an A1 configuration; c1 is not refitted or scored on Track G; G-A4 is reworded to match; reports state that c2 was not the selected v2.
points.reason: G-A4 gives the cap of 1 to the frozen v2 while G-A2 makes c2 primary and also reports c1, which is two configurations. A coordinate model cannot be the transfer candidate outside the US.
